answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 1049 Country: IE Title: I am a Muslim, but i working for a MNC of USA company. Let me know. Can i eat birth day party sweets? Question: I am a Muslim, but i working for a MNC of USA company. Let me know. Can i eat birth day party sweets? Answer ID: 1049 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 477/465=N) Celebrating birthday is against the teachings of Islam and it is a custom of others. It is not right to participate in such programmes and have feast over there. Yet, if a non-Muslim offers you sweet without participating in birthday programme then there is no wrong with accepting the gift. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
